correctness.rationale: Reconstructed Pappus adjacency independently from the LCF [5,7,-7,7,-7,-5]^3: 18 vertices, 27 edges, all 2598 augmented independent faces, GF2 boundary ranks (1,17,109,329,472,274,74,16,2) and rational homology concentrated in degree four of dimension 10 by UCT and Euler. NetworkX graph isomorphism search independently found exactly 216 automorphisms and 13 conjugacy classes. For each of the 216 permutations, directly enumerated setwise fixed independent faces with orientation signs and recovered the source 13-class Lefschetz table, total invariant average zero. Inspected source’s full rational class-algebra multiplication certificate construction and character splitting into degree 4 and degree 6: squared character norm 1 and 169 class-algebra products, multiplicity-one rational descent. In rational characteristic zero the transfer relation identifies quotient rational homology with invariants. The result is finite but exhaustive for the one fixed graph.
